play: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (window.COACH && COACH.closeOffer) COACH.closeOffer(); const A = DomApp; if (!A.table) A.startGame({ seed: 7, first: 0, kingdom: ['Cellar', 'Market', 'Merchant', 'Militia', 'Mine', 'Moat', 'Remodel', 'Smithy', 'Village', 'Workshop'], edition: 2, level: 'easy', opps: 1 }); await w(300); window.__n = A.table.state.actions.length; window.__turns = A.table.view(0).turns.length; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const v = A.table.view(0); const p = v.pending; if (!p) { await w(100); continue; } if (p.kind === 'action') { A.ui.btnLock = 0; A.act(-1); await w(150); continue; } if (p.kind === 'buy') { A.ui.btnLock = 0; A.act(v.coins >= 3 ? played: (() => { const t = DomApp.table; if (!t) return false; const v = t.view(0); return t.state.actions.length > window.__n && v.turns.length >= window.__turns + 2 && !!v.pending && !v.over; })()
